# smart-base-house-processes

The BPMN this layer owns as house processes, under `content/`: `classify-and-code-content.bpmn`, and two point-of-care processes any DAK calls by call activity, `questionnaire-data-capture.bpmn` (a health worker completes an SDC form, the system extracts its resources) and `act-on-decision-support.bpmn` (the system applies a PlanDefinition, the health worker accepts or declines, may note why on a branch nothing waits for, and the care plan is updated). The processes that run on the work plan and the delivery process (`l2-dak-authoring`, `l2-component-edit-review`, `smart-guideline-end-to-end`, `dth-authoring`, `SGAuthoring.DAKLifecycle`, `dak-l3-ig`) moved to the opt-in `collab/` with DIIG's `diig-investment-path` (owner, 2026-11-13). [Skill](https://litlfred.github.io/bootstrap/schemas/#skill) refs this layer does not own resolve down through `fhir-harness`. cat-harness-tools' `render:bpmn` draws each beside its source (bean folio-assistant-akiq); folio-assistant's just-the-docs site, which mounts this directory, shows them.

Part of [SMART Base](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-base-house-processes`, holding `processes`.
